title: Registration of Documents (Amendment) Law
long_title: A LAW TO AMEND THE REGISTRATION OF DOCUMENTS ORDINANCE.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: National State Assembly of the Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:- Short title
body.raw_text: 1. This Law may be cited as the Registration of Documents (Amendment) Law, No. 4 of 1974.
body.text: This Law may be cited as the Registration of Documents (Amendment) Law, No. 4 of 1974.

body.heading: Repeal of section 2a of the Registration of Documents Ordinance
body.raw_text: 2. Section 2A of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (inserted therein by Act No. 27 of 1969) is hereby repealed.
body.text: Section 2A of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (inserted therein by Act No. 27 of 1969) is hereby repealed.
